properties.select_sql: SELECT ParmName, ParmValue FROM INTEGRAMASTER_V2.dbo.ClientProperties WHERE ClientId = @ClientId AND ParmName IN ('DATASOURCE_LOCATION', 'LAST_TRANSACTION_BATCH', 'OASIS_DB');
properties.update_last_batch_sql: UPDATE INTEGRAMASTER_V2.dbo.ClientProperties SET ParmValue = @ParmValue WHERE ClientId = @ClientId AND ParmName = 'LAST_TRANSACTION_BATCH';

target.insert_template: INSERT INTO {OASIS_DB}.dbo.TransactionLog (Id, TransactionId, TransactionStatement, BatchTime, BatchId) VALUES (@Id, @TransactionId, @TransactionStatement, GETDATE(), @BatchId);
